items.q: A rectangular rug is 9 feet long and 4 feet wide. A square rug has the same area as the rectangular rug. What is the side length of the square rug?

items.e: The mean is (12 + 20 + 8 + 15 + 15) ÷ 5 = 70 ÷ 5 = 14, and the median of 8, 12, 15, 15, 20 is 15, so the median is greater by 1.
items.q: Five plants have heights of 12, 20, 8, 15, and 15 centimeters. Which is greater, the mean height or the median height, and by how much?

items.e: 12 × 15 = 180 stickers are handed out, and 187 − 180 = 7 stickers are left over.
items.q: A club has 187 stickers to share equally among 12 members. If each member gets the same whole number of stickers, how many stickers are left over?

items.e: The three angles total 180°, so the two equal angles share 180 − 90 = 90°, and 90 ÷ 2 = 45° each.
items.q: One angle of a triangle measures 90°, and the other two angles are equal to each other. What is the measure, in degrees, of each of those two equal angles?

items.e: Because 36 ÷ 4 = 9, we get 3.6 ÷ 4 = 0.9 liter in each bottle, and 0.9 × 4 = 3.6 checks it.
items.q: A jug holds 3.6 liters of water. The water is poured equally into 4 bottles. How many liters of water are in each bottle?

items.e: The box holds 5 × 4 × 3 = 60 cubes, and 60 − 45 = 15 cubes are still in it.
items.q: A box is 5 inches long, 4 inches wide, and 3 inches tall, and it is completely filled with 1-inch cubes. If 45 of the cubes are taken out, how many cubes are still in the box?

items.e: Two of the six letters in PENCIL are vowels, so the probability is 2/6, which simplifies to 1/3.
items.q: Each letter of the word PENCIL is written on its own card, making 6 cards. The cards are turned face down and mixed, and one card is picked at random. What is the probability that the card picked shows a vowel?
